name: Harvest Pairs
description: A calm card puzzle. Clear a stacked triangle of cards by pairing two that add up to 13, with leaves, acorns, berries and shells. A deal each day, or a new one whenever you like.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Twenty-eight cards sit in a stacked triangle of seven rows, with a draw pile and a waste pile below. Remove cards in pairs that add up to 13.
help.goal: Clear every card from the triangle. The draw pile does not have to be emptied. There is no timer.
howToPlay: Only uncovered cards can be used: a card is free when no card in the row below overlaps it.
Pick a free card, then pick another free card so their values add up to 13. Ace is 1, Jack 11, Queen 12. A King is 13 and goes alone: pick it once.

Draw a card onto the waste pile when you need one. The top of the waste pile can pair with a free card. When the draw pile runs out, turn the waste pile over and go through it again as often as you like.

Each deal is checked with a solver before it is dealt, so it can be cleared. If you take a path that cannot be cleared, the game tells you, and Undo takes any number of moves back. Today's deal is the same for everyone today.

controls.action: Move between free cards, and down to the draw and waste piles
Pick up a card, pair it with another, or draw
Draw a card, or turn the waste pile over
Undo, as many moves as you like
Reach Undo, Restart and the deal buttons

tips: Each card reads its value and suit aloud, for example 7 of Acorns. The suits are Leaves, Acorns, Berries and Shells, and each also has its own shape.
Before pairing, check whether another card could use the same partner, for example two 5s and one 8.
Kings never need a partner, so take them as soon as they are free.
You can stop at any time. Your deal and your undo history are saved.
